title: DISINFO: Poland wants to seize Western Ukraine and Western Belarus
claim: The Poles want to take over Western Belarus and Western Ukraine and dominate there. This is unacceptable. If the Poles enter Ukraine and try to occupy the western part, we (Belarus) will support the Ukrainians because we understand that we will be next.
fact: Recurrent pro-Kremlin disinformation narrative presenting Poland as an aggressive anti-Russian and anti-Belarusian state with imperial ambitions.
attribution: wypowiedź przypisana stronie białoruskiej (tag: Alexander Lukashenko), portal livenews.am i Telegram
usage: Krótki cytat z podaniem EUvsDisinfo i linku. Treść przypadku to analiza EUvsDisinfo; nie przypisuje intencji autorom nowych wiadomości.
